use_case_summary: Workload: product Q&A for storefront chat + catalog enrichment (title, bullets, alt-text). Targets: 100ms-300ms p95 for chat widget responses; can accept higher p95 for enrichment jobs. Throughput: typical low sustained, bursts to 50-80 rps for short periods. Cost sensitivity: moderate — wants cost per enriched SKU < $0.15. Model preference: small-to-medium open models (quantized) or Redwood-verified variants; fallback to lower-cost variants during bursts. Routing/fallback: prefer single-region US hosted with automatic cheaper-variant fallback under capacity pressure. Security: SOC2 + audit logs enough for now; will ask about retention controls later.

POC scope (4 weeks):
- Week 1: connect sample catalog, run enrichment batch (10k SKUs) -> generate candidate titles/alt-text + admin diff UI.
- Week 2: wire chat widget to hosted API, test product Q&A with 200 intents. Measure latency and token usage.

technical_constraints: No on-prem. Uses Shopify + Vercel frontend. Wants API key-based auth only for now. CSV SKU IDs are inconsistent (need normalization). Prefers SDK in Node.js. Concern: front-end latency budget 300ms p95; will accept streaming if needed.
decision_criteria:
- Accuracy on SKU attribute extraction (precision > 90% for brand/size)
- Cost per enriched SKU < $0.15
- Fast recovery under bursts (automatic fallback)
- Minimal engineering effort to integrate (samples + SDKs)
